dimensions.name: Form Specificity
dimensions.description: Does the listing specify the magnesium form (glycinate, citrate, oxide)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No form mentioned. 3: Generic 'magnesium' only. 5: Form named but not explained. 7: Form named with brief benefit (e.g. 'gentle on stomach'). 10: Form named, explained why it matters (absorption, bioavailability), compared to inferior forms.

dimensions.name: Dosage Clarity
dimensions.description: Is dosage per serving clearly stated with elemental magnesium amount?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No dosage info. 3: Total mg only. 5: Per-serving mg stated. 7: Elemental mg clearly distinguished from compound mg. 10: Elemental mg, servings per container, and recommended daily intake context all present.

dimensions.name: Third-Party Testing
dimensions.description: Is USP, NSF, ConsumerLab, or other third-party verification mentioned?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None mentioned. 3: Vague 'tested' claim. 5: One certification named. 7: Specific certification body with detail. 10: Multiple certifications (USP + NSF + GMP) with certificate or badge reference.

dimensions.name: Bioavailability Claims
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No mention. 3: Vague 'easy to absorb'. 5: States 'high bioavailability'. 7: Explains why glycinate form absorbs better. 10: Quantified bioavailability data or clinical reference comparing absorption rates.

dimensions.name: Allergen & Dietary Callouts
dimensions.description: Are gluten-free, vegan, soy-free, non-GMO, and other dietary certifications stated?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 3: One callout. 5: 2-3 callouts. 7: Comprehensive dietary status (gluten-free, vegan, soy-free, non-GMO). 10: Full allergen statement plus dietary certifications with clear formatting.

dimensions.name: Use-Case Positioning
dimensions.description: Are specific outcomes targeted (sleep, stress, muscle, migraine, bone health)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No use cases. 3: Generic 'health support'. 5: One specific use case. 7: 2-3 targeted use cases. 10: Multiple specific outcomes with context on who benefits most.

dimensions.name: Serving Value
dimensions.description: Are servings per container and cost-per-serving communicated?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No serving info. 3: Capsule count only. 5: Servings per container stated. 7: Servings plus supply duration (e.g. '2-month supply'). 10: Clear value proposition with servings, supply duration, and cost-per-serving context.

dimensions.name: Keyword Coverage
dimensions.description: Does the listing include category-relevant search terms that top competitors use?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: Minimal keywords. 3: Basic product name only. 5: Some relevant keywords. 7: Good keyword coverage in title and bullets. 10: Comprehensive keyword strategy matching or exceeding top 10 competitors.

dimensions.name: Trust Signals
dimensions.description: Are GMP, FDA-registered facility, made in USA, cGMP, or similar trust markers present?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 3: One vague claim. 5: GMP or made in USA stated. 7: Multiple trust signals clearly stated. 10: Comprehensive trust framework (GMP + FDA-registered + made in USA + satisfaction guarantee).
